The graph shows a portion of the curve $y=\operatorname{tan}⁡x$ and $y=-1.$ Which of the following generates the $x$-values of all of their points of intersection? Assume that $n$ is an integer.
worked_solution:
At the intersection points, the $y$-values are the same for both graphs. This gives the equation $\operatorname{tan}⁡x=-1.$ 

First, we find the principal value:

$$
{x}_{1}=\operatorname{arctan}⁡(-1)=-\frac{\pi }{4}
$$

The tangent function has a period of $\pi .$  Hence, the general solution for the given equation is

$$
x=-\frac{\pi }{4}+n\pi .
$$
